title: HIV-associated dementia: microglial nodules + multinucleated giant cells
vignette: A 42-year-old man with advanced HIV infection is evaluated for several months of progressive memory loss, poor concentration, and psychomotor slowing. He has not been taking antiretroviral therapy, and his most recent CD4 count is 45/mm3 (normal 500-1500). Neurologic examination shows impaired attention and slowed movements without focal motor deficits. Brain MRI reveals diffuse cerebral atrophy without focal enhancing lesions. Which of the following findings is most likely present on histologic examination of this patient's brain?

clues.note: Advanced, untreated HIV sets the stage for direct CNS infection by the virus itself (HIV encephalitis), distinct from opportunistic infections.

clues.text: progressive memory loss, poor concentration, and psychomotor slowing
clues.note: A subacute, progressive subcortical dementia (memory, attention, slowed processing/movement) is the clinical picture of HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder.
CD4 45 / normal 500-1500 is profound immunosuppression (AIDS); HIV-associated dementia typically occurs at very low CD4 counts.

clues.text: diffuse cerebral atrophy without focal enhancing lesions
clues.note: Diffuse atrophy WITHOUT focal enhancing/mass lesions argues against toxoplasmosis or CNS lymphoma and supports diffuse HIV encephalitis.

whatMatters: Untreated advanced HIV (CD4 45) with a progressive subcortical dementia and diffuse atrophy (no focal lesions) = HIV encephalitis / HIV-associated dementia, caused by the virus itself. Histology shows MICROGLIAL NODULES and MULTINUCLEATED GIANT CELLS (formed by fusion of HIV-infected macrophages/microglia) - the pathologic hallmark. Answer D.
strategy: Separate 'the virus itself' (diffuse encephalitis) from opportunistic CNS processes (focal enhancing lesions). Diffuse atrophy + subcortical dementia at low CD4 = HIV encephalitis, whose signature is microglial nodules with multinucleated giant cells. Reject Cowdry A inclusions (HSV), Negri bodies (rabies), and demyelination without inflammation (PML/JC virus).

options.text: Microglial nodules with multinucleated giant cells
Non-inflammatory demyelination with enlarged oligodendrocyte nuclei

eliminations.label: Cowdry A intranuclear inclusions - HSV encephalitis
eliminations.detail: WHAT IT IS: eosinophilic intranuclear (Cowdry A) inclusions seen in herpes simplex encephalitis. ❌ WHY IT FAILS: HSV causes an acute hemorrhagic, temporal-lobe encephalitis, not a chronic diffuse dementia. ✅ Correct if: acute fever + temporal-lobe necrosis/hemorrhage.

eliminations.label: Substantia nigra depigmentation - Parkinson disease
eliminations.detail: WHAT IT IS: loss of pigmented dopaminergic neurons in Parkinson disease. ❌ WHY IT FAILS: it causes a movement disorder (tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia), not an HIV-driven dementia. ✅ Correct if: parkinsonism with Lewy bodies.

eliminations.label: Negri bodies - rabies
eliminations.detail: WHAT IT IS: intracytoplasmic Negri bodies (in hippocampal/Purkinje neurons) of rabies. ❌ WHY IT FAILS: rabies causes encephalitis with hydrophobia after an animal bite, not a subacute HIV dementia. ✅ Correct if: encephalitis after a bat/dog bite.

eliminations.label: Non-inflammatory demyelination + enlarged oligodendrocyte nuclei - PML (JC virus)
eliminations.detail: WHAT IT IS: progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy from JC virus - demyelination with enlarged oligodendrocyte nuclei, minimal inflammation. ❌ WHY IT FAILS: PML gives multifocal white-matter (often nonenhancing) lesions with focal deficits, not diffuse atrophy with multinucleated giant cells. ✅ Correct if: multifocal white-matter lesions + focal neuro deficits in AIDS.

reasoning: Untreated advanced HIV (CD4 45) + progressive subcortical dementia + diffuse atrophy without focal lesions
This is HIV encephalitis (HIV-associated dementia) caused by the virus itself
HIV-infected macrophages/microglia fuse into multinucleated giant cells and aggregate as microglial nodules
-> microglial nodules with multinucleated giant cells; answer D
mechanism: In advanced, untreated HIV, the virus enters the CNS within infected monocytes/macrophages ('Trojan horse'). Productive infection of perivascular macrophages and microglia - not neurons directly - drives neuronal injury through release of viral proteins (gp120, Tat) and inflammatory cytokines, producing a diffuse subcortical dementia (impaired memory/attention, psychomotor slowing) with cerebral atrophy and no focal mass lesions. The pathologic hallmark of HIV encephalitis is aggregates of activated microglia (MICROGLIAL NODULES) together with MULTINUCLEATED GIANT CELLS, formed when HIV-infected macrophages/microglia fuse. HIV-associated dementia occurs at very low CD4 counts and is treated by starting effective antiretroviral therapy. The distractors are signatures of other CNS diseases: Cowdry A inclusions (HSV), substantia nigra depigmentation (Parkinson), Negri bodies (rabies), and non-inflammatory demyelination with enlarged oligodendrocyte nuclei (JC virus/PML).

difficulty.label: 📚 Pure knowledge gap
difficulty.message: First Aid Micro/Neuro > HIV encephalitis: microglial nodules + multinucleated giant cells; HIV-infected macrophages/microglia; low CD4; subcortical dementia; treat with ART.

difficulty.label: 🧭 Understanding the question
difficulty.message: Diffuse atrophy without focal lesions signals the virus itself (encephalitis), not an opportunistic mass - recall its histology.

difficulty.label: 🔤 Vocabulary
difficulty.message: Unsure on microglial nodule, multinucleated giant cell, subcortical dementia, or PML/JC virus? Tell me which.

difficulty.label: 🧲 Pulled by a distractor
difficulty.message: Cowdry A = HSV, Negri bodies = rabies, substantia nigra loss = Parkinson, demyelination + enlarged oligodendrocytes = PML - all other CNS diseases.

difficulty.label: ✍️ Something else
difficulty.message: Bank: HIV-associated dementia -> microglial nodules + multinucleated giant cells; caused by virus in macrophages/microglia.

memoryHook: HIV smuggles itself into the brain inside macrophages that fuse into giant cells - microglial nodules + multinucleated giant cells are its calling card.
